wins: Mapped perimeter services in ep001_step02 and identified vulnerable HTTP and SSH ports within first five minutes
Captured valid local credentials via exposed HTTP endpoint verification in ep001_step08
fails: Could not escalate beyond initial foothold; privilege escalation attempts failed due to missing sudo access at ep001_step12
Repeated failure to pivot to adjacent subnet services despite 10 mentor hints, leaving lateral movement untested
key_outcomes.summary: Solid reconnaissance revealed attack surface and credentials, but the run stalled during privilege escalation and lateral movement, preventing success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts consistently failed because sudo rights were absent and no alternative exploits were tried

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 is open and an HTTP server banner is confirmed
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster directory brute force followed by nikto for quick vulnerability spotting

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH service on port 22 accepts banner but password auth is enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Use hydra with username list gathered from HTTP enumeration

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid local user credentials obtained
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo privileges and check /etc/sudoers, then run LinPEAS

memory_ops.reason: High precision reconnaissance revealed actionable HTTP directories leading to credential discovery
